_doc: The Boki summon (KinSummon, decisions 0039, 0044): killed_cd_mult = cooldown x after a rival hunter kills it, home_speed = m/s the wisp flies home, reveal_s = s its owner shows on the killer squad's minimap; [window s, cooldown s] by the species' ai.role and body.size (briefs/boki-art/WISP_DESIGN_OPEN.md Q1). Uptime = window / (window + cooldown) stays in uptime_band. leash: m, how far from its Hunter a summoned Boki wanders before it turns back (short and fixed, because a timed window cannot afford a Boki 17 m away: Q7); leash_swing: m, the most a bold or shy personality moves it (+-); rebloom_dist: m, past this (a dash, a glide, a pull) it re-blooms beside the Hunter instead of walking, the window still running. knock_band: the summoned Boki's share of a 1v1 knock's damage (decision 0043, --summon-share-check); dmg_k: x each species' damage while summoned to land it there (1 when unlisted; the check prints k_now).

steal._doc: Stolen Boki wisps (KinSteal, decision 0041, WISP_DESIGN_OPEN.md Q6/Q8): loose_s = s a downed hunter's wisp floats loose; grab_r = m reach, grab_s = s holding interact; carry_max = stolen wisps one hunter carries; passive_k = share of each stolen carry passive; summon_k = share of its window for the one stolen summon, at least summon_min_s s.
